metadata.title: Automatic Speech Recognition Pricing | Free Beta
metadata.description: Compare automatic speech recognition pricing for the free ASR workflow planner and custom team rollout support. Start at $0 with Google sign-in.

content.title: Automatic speech recognition pricing
content.description: Start with the workflow planner at no cost. Move to a scoped team rollout when your audio volume, accuracy target, integrations, and governance requirements are clear.

plans.name: Free Beta
plans.description: For individuals evaluating an ASR workflow before selecting a model, API, or vendor.
plans.note: No card required. Google sign-in is the only account method.

plans.name: Team Rollout
plans.description: For teams turning a benchmark into a production transcription or voice workflow.
plans.note: Scope is based on audio volume, integrations, review effort, and security needs.
features: Retention, privacy, and human review plan

content.footnote: The site does not currently sell usage credits or subscriptions. Team rollout pricing is not presented until the workflow has a defined volume, quality target, integration boundary, and review process.
